@appName.description: The app's name; do not translate.

errorNetwork: Can't reach Ozone. Check your connection and try again.
errorServer: Ozone is having trouble right now. Try again shortly.
errorUsernameTaken: That username is taken. Try another.
errorKonamiIdTaken: That Konami ID is linked to another Ozone account. Contact Ozone support if it's yours.
errorAccountUnavailable: This account is suspended. Contact Ozone support.
errorInvalidCode: That code is wrong or has expired.
errorSignInUnavailable: That sign-in option isn't available yet. Try again later.
errorInvalidIdentityToken: Sign-in didn't go through. Try again.
errorIdentityProviderUnavailable: Can't reach the sign-in service right now. Try again shortly.
errorInvalidKonamiId: Enter the Konami ID exactly as eFootball shows it.
errorInvalidUsername: Use 3 to 24 letters, numbers, underscores or dots.
errorProfileIncomplete: Finish setting up your account first.
errorEmailTaken: That email belongs to another account.
errorEmailAlreadyVerified: That email is already verified on your account.
errorEmailUnavailable: We can't send email right now. Try again shortly.
errorInvalidEmail: That doesn't look like an email address.
errorPhoneTaken: That number is linked to another Ozone account. Contact Ozone support if it's yours.
errorInvalidPhone: Enter the full number with its country code.
errorWithdrawalClosed: Registration has closed, so you can't withdraw now.
errorRefundRequestExists: You've already asked for a refund.
errorRateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.

closesInMinutes: {minutes, plural, =1{Closes in 1 min} other{Closes in {minutes} min}}
closesInHours: {hours, plural, =1{Closes in 1 hour} other{Closes in {hours} hours}}
closesInDays: {days, plural, =1{Closes in 1 day} other{Closes in {days} days}}
